top_repos.name: Anemia_detection
top_repos.description: Anemia detection using deep learning, designed for rural India where anemia-related complications, especially in pregnant women, are common and access to medical help is limited. The project includes tools for color correction, image segmentation, data cleaning, multiple predictive models. Patient data remains private; similar public data is used.

top_repos.name: Gym_Style_Snake
top_repos.description: Snake game Reinforcement Learning agent written fully compatible with the gym environment to be used interchangible and suitable for any RL library (SB3, RLlib, custom code, etc.)

top_repos.name: vision-language-action_robocar
top_repos.description: Integrating a vision-language-action(code) model to a simple $30 robotic car from amazon for autonomous control with the purpose to evaluate the robustness and limits of current models for future use in more complex projects with real world usage

top_repos.name: PPO_from_scratch
top_repos.description: implementation of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) Reinforcement Learning algorithm from scratch, following the algorithm in the original OpenAI paper. To be uploaded: custom gym-style env from scratch end experiments of custom reward creation on it
